app.name: PanelPilot
app.tagline: Diagnostic and design copilot for electrical and control engineers.

diagnosis.checkParameter: Check parameter <param>21.03</param> against the supply of <volts>400 V</volts>.

tokens.title: Design tokens
tokens.intro: Every value below resolves to a CSS custom property.

diagnosticCard.heading: Diagnosis
diagnosticCard.uncertainWithSources: There is not enough supporting evidence to give steps for this. Check the documentation below before acting.
diagnosticCard.uncertainNoSources: There is not enough supporting evidence to give steps for this. Check the equipment documentation before acting.
diagnosticCard.refusalFallback: This question could not be answered from the available documentation.

chat.empty: Describe the fault you are seeing.
chat.placeholder: e.g. ACS880 tripping on undervoltage at start

failed.heading: This answer did not finish
failed.connection-lost: The connection dropped before the answer was complete. Nothing shown is missing — there is no partial answer to read.
failed.malformed-frame: The answer arrived damaged and was discarded rather than shown in part.
failed.server-error: The server could not start this answer.
failed.unauthorized: Your session had expired, so this answer was not started. It has been renewed — try again.
failed.quota-exhausted: You have used all your free questions. Create an account to keep asking.
failed.account-quota-exhausted: You have used all the free questions on this account.

context.editLabel: Set the equipment for this session

capture.stillUploading: Still uploading — this connection is slow, not stuck.
capture.storedNoReading: The photo was uploaded, but nothing read it. Describe the fault code and it will be diagnosed as usual.
capture.pleaseConfirm: Please confirm what this shows before it is diagnosed:
capture.messageNoCode: A fault is shown on the display

verdict.not_a_fault_display: This does not look like a fault display.
verdict.unreadable: The display could not be read from this photo.

error.not-an-image: That file is not an image.
error.too-large-after-compression: The photo is too large to upload even after compression.
error.decode-failed: The photo could not be opened. Try taking it again.
error.encode-failed: The photo could not be processed on this device.
error.too-large: The server rejected the photo as too large.
error.network: The photo could not be uploaded. Check the connection and try again.
error.unavailable: Photo upload is not available right now.
error.timeout: The upload took too long and was stopped.
error.unauthorized: Your session had expired, so the photo was not uploaded. It has been renewed — try again.
error.too-large-to-process: That photo is too large to process. Try a smaller one.

trial.heading: Keep going
trial.keepsConversation: Your conversation carries over — nothing is lost.

error.email-taken: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
error.trial-gone: This trial has expired, so the conversation cannot be carried over. The account can still be created.
error.failed: The account could not be created. Check the connection and try again.

landing.headline: Diagnose a fault without signing up
landing.subhead: Ask a question now. No access request, no waiting.
landing.unavailable: The free trial is not available right now. Sign in to continue.

verification.heading: Verification queue
verification.sourceMissing: No source available for this item.
verification.notePlaceholder: Say what is wrong, and where.
verification.contentMissing: The text of this item could not be loaded. Do not label it until it can be read.
verification.openSource: Open the source in a new tab

landing.unavailable: Trials are unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.
landing.rateLimited: Too many trials have been started from this network. Wait a few minutes and try again, or sign in.

plc.heading: Check PLC code
plc.intro: Paste IEC 61131-3 Structured Text. It is checked for syntax errors, undeclared or unused tags, type mismatches and unreachable code, each shown on its line. Nothing is stored.
plc.label: Structured Text
plc.placeholder:
PROGRAM Main
  VAR
    Start : BOOL;
  END_VAR
  ...
END_PROGRAM
plc.rejected: That program could not be checked.
plc.failed: The check could not run. Try again.

plcView.failed: {count, plural, one {Validation failed — # error} other {Validation failed — # errors}}
plcView.notVerified: Not verified — this code was not checked
plcView.passed: {count, plural, one {Passed with # warning} other {Passed with # warnings}}
plcView.unverifiedNote: An unverified result is not a verified-correct one. Do not deploy this without checking it yourself.
plcView.ladderLabel: {count, plural, one {Ladder diagram, # rung} other {Ladder diagram, # rungs}}

error.invalid: That email and password do not match an account.
error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.failed: Could not sign in. Check the connection and try again.

review.heading: Review queue
review.intro: Sign in with a reviewer account to work your queue. Each item is labelled against its source; a correct label publishes it.
review.forbidden: This account does not hold the reviewer role. An administrator grants it.
review.failed: Your queue could not be loaded.
